hook_text: A tuck shop sold 34 vetkoek on Friday. Or did it sell 17? It depends on one tiny number you probably skipped.
clip_script: Tuck shop in Bethlehem. Bar graph of vetkoek sold. Friday's bar is the tallest. How many? Check the scale first: it counts in 2s. Read straight across: 34. If you assumed 1s, you would say 17. Wrong! Now how many more on Friday than Thursday? Thursday is 16. 34 minus 16: 18 more. The whole week? Add the bars: 112. Now a pie chart: 40 learners and their sports. Half is soccer, 20. A quarter is netball, 10. An eighth each for cricket and athletics, 5 and 5. Title, labels, scale first. Then the bars tell the truth.
visual_style: Whiteboard bar graph with the scale circled before the bars light up; a pie chart splitting into a half, a quarter and two eighths with numbers appearing.
pacing: The scale trap, the right reading, two quick calculations, then the pie chart.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find a graph in a newspaper to read from the outside in.
